name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for waiver of the immunity of Petras Gražulis
part_text:
The European Parliament has decided to lift the legal protection that Petras Gražulis, a Lithuanian member of the European Parliament, holds as a parliamentarian. Lithuania's top prosecutor asked for this because Gražulis is accused of publicly mocking a group of people because of their sexual orientation, in comments made in 2022 when he was a member of the Lithuanian parliament. Lifting his protection lets the criminal case against him go ahead in Lithuania.

- **What changes:** Gražulis loses his parliamentary protection, so Lithuania can pursue the criminal case against him.
- **Who it affects:** Petras Gražulis, a member of the European Parliament from Lithuania, and the Lithuanian courts.
- **What happens next:** The Parliament's President sends the decision to the Lithuanian authorities and to Gražulis.
